verifications.notes: The route maps POST /register to AccountController::register, but the controller code is not shown. Registration typically does not require an ownership check, so the evidence is insufficient to confirm a missing check.

The route maps POST /posts to AccountController::post. The controller implementation is not visible; creating a post usually does not involve an ownership check on the target resource, so the evidence is insufficient.

The route maps POST /teams to AccountController::team. The controller code is not shown; team creation typically does not require an ownership check on an existing resource, so the evidence is insufficient.
The rename endpoint loads a User by the uid from the URL and updates the name without verifying that uid matches the authenticated user. No ownership check is present.
The patch endpoint loads a User by uid from the URL and applies arbitrary updates without checking ownership. No ownership verification is present.
